task:
Open the file /home/user/Documents/product_overview.odp in LibreOffice Impress. This 4-slide deck has: Slide 1 = title 'Orbit CRM' with subtitle 'Learn more'; Slide 2 = 'Features' with 3 bullets; Slide 3 = 'Pricing' with 3 bullets; Slide 4 = 'Contact' with 3 lines.

Add an entrance (Entry) animation to the body/bullet-list placeholder on Slide 2, Slide 3, and Slide 4 so that when the slide is presented, the bullets animate in. Turn the text 'Learn more' inside the subtitle of Slide 1 into a hyperlink pointing to https://www.libreoffice.org. Save the file, overwriting /home/user/Documents/product_overview.odp. Keep the .odp extension.

The deck must still have exactly 4 slides when you finish.

verification.description: Slide 2 has at least one animation element
Slide 3 has at least one animation element
Slide 4 has at least one animation element
Slide 1 has a hyperlink on text 'Learn more' to libreoffice.org
